title: Neck and shoulders
intro: Release the tension that builds up while you stare at the screen.

steps.text: Roll your shoulders backwards, slowly, in big circles
Now roll them forwards
Tilt your head to the right, ear towards your shoulder
Tilt your head to the left
Chin to chest, let the weight of your head stretch your neck
Shrug your shoulders up to your ears, hold 3s and drop. Repeat

title: Wrists and hands
intro: Keyboard and mouse punish your forearms. Give them 2 minutes.

steps.text: Right arm straight, palm out, gently pull your fingers back with the other hand
Same with the left arm
Palm down now, pull your fingers towards you (right arm)
And the left arm
Open and close your hands hard and fast
Rotate your wrists in both directions

title: Moving spine
intro: Stand up. Your spine loves moving in every direction.

steps.text: Standing, hands on knees: round your back (cat), then arch it (cow), alternating
Arms up, lean your torso to the right
And to the left
Feet planted, twist your torso side to side, arms loose
Roll down one vertebra at a time, then roll back up slowly

title: Squats
intro: Get your legs working and your blood flowing.

steps.text: 15 slow squats: hips back, chest open
Rest and shake out your legs
Hold a half squat, as if sitting on an invisible chair
Rest
10 more squats, driving up faster
Get a glass of water and drink all of it
Walk around (stairs, hallway, balcony) without looking at your phone
Before sitting down, have a big stretch with your arms overhead

title: 20-20-20 for your eyes
intro: Your eyes need a break too. Step away from the screen.

steps.text: Look at something more than 6 metres away, ideally out of a window
Blink slowly and deliberately, 20 times
Close your eyes and cover them with warm palms
Eyes closed: look up, down, left and right
Trace a sideways 8 with your eyes, slowly

title: Open your chest
intro: Counteract the hunched posture of a day at the computer.

steps.text: Interlace your hands behind your back, straighten your arms and open your chest
Forearm against a door frame, turn your body away from it (right side)
Same on the left side
Hands behind your head, elbows back, look slightly up

title: Calves and ankles
intro: Helps circulation in legs that sit still for hours.

steps.text: 20 slow calf raises
Balance on your right foot only
Balance on your left foot only
Rotate your ankles in both directions
15 more calf raises, holding 2s at the top

title: Mini cardio
intro: 2 minutes to wake your body up. Adjust the intensity to your space.

steps.text: Jumping jacks (or side steps if you have neighbours below)
Rest
High knees, alternating, fast pace
Rest
Run on the spot
Breathe deeply and slow down

title: Desk push-ups
intro: Hands on the edge of your desk (make sure it's stable!), body straight.

steps.text: 10 to 15 incline push-ups
Rest and shake out your arms
Incline plank with your hands on the desk
Rest
10 more push-ups, lowering slowly

title: Box breathing
intro: Lowers stress and clears your head. Sit up straight or stand, away from the screen.

steps.text: Breathe in 4s, hold 4s, breathe out 4s, hold 4s
Keep the cycle going, eyes closed
Breathe normally and notice how you feel

title: Hip flexors
intro: Sitting shortens the muscles at the front of your hips.

steps.text: Lunge with your right foot forward, push your hips forward
Switch: left foot forward
Standing, grab your right foot behind you (quads), hold on to something if needed
Left foot
Feet wide apart, slowly reach towards the floor

title: Wall angels
intro: Back and head against a wall, feet a hand's width away from it.

steps.text: Arms in a W against the wall, slide them up into a Y and back. Slowly
Rest
Chin tucks (double chin), hold 5s and repeat
One more set of angels, keeping your lower back against the wall

title: Plank and core
intro: You'll need a bit of floor.

steps.text: Forearm plank (or with knees down)
Rest
Side plank, right side
Side plank, left side
Lying on your back, hug your knees and rock gently
